name: cdn-purge
description: Purges changed pages from Cloudflare, Bunny or Fastly when you publish, update or delete content, so a CDN in front of your site stays fresh.

zone_id.title: Cloudflare zone ID
zone_id.description: Used when the provider is Cloudflare.

pull_zone_id.title: Bunny pull zone ID
pull_zone_id.description: Used when the provider is Bunny.

service_id.title: Fastly service ID
service_id.description: Used when the provider is Fastly.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Cloudflare API token, Bunny account API key or Fastly API token with purge rights. Stored in the settings only; never shown again.

also_purge.title: Also purge these paths
also_purge.description: One path per line. Purged together with the changed page, for example the home page, a blog index or the feeds.

purge_everything_on_change.title: Purge everything on every change
purge_everything_on_change.description: Drop the whole CDN cache instead of single URLs whenever content is published, updated or deleted.

site_url.title: Site URL
site_url.description: Origin such as https://example.com; used only when the host gives a path without an origin
